statement: RunPod's Secure Cloud on-demand price for NVIDIA H100 SXM is $2.99 per GPU-hour on 2026-08-05.
why: H100 SXM is the common reference part across GPU rental vendors, so a published per-GPU-hour rate marks where the going rate for mainstream accelerator capacity sits.

impact.mechanism: A published per-GPU-hour rate sets the cost renters compare against and determines the revenue an operator earns per hour on merchant-GPU capacity.

confidence.basis: Verbatim vendor list price, but secondary-tier open-web evidence from a single publisher (RunPod) with no separately fetched corroborating document, so confidence cannot exceed medium.

dispersion: Same-family H100 variants span $2.89 (PCIe) to $3.19 (NVL) per GPU-hour on the same page.
